body: Referees increasingly use large language models (LLMs), while finance and accounting journals disagree about whether to allow it. We ask which part of a referee's job the models can do. GPT-4o, whose training data end before the 2024 conference season, referees the papers presented at the 2024 AFA and NBER finance meetings, and we compare its verdicts with publication in the top-three finance journals over the next two years. Papers the model scores one standard deviation higher are 44% more likely to be published, net of author reputation. The result is not driven by look-ahead bias, as the model does not recall the outcomes. The information comes from its judgements of correctness and exposition. Its judgements of originality and significance carry none, and a referee guide that stresses importance does not help. The split between correctness and contribution holds for accounting papers and for a newer model, GPT-5. LLMs can check whether research is right, but not whether it matters. The technical check can go to the model, while the judgement of contribution stays with people.
summaryZh: 本文通过对比GPT-4o与GPT-5在金融与会计领域顶级会议论文评审中的表现，探讨了大模型在学术同行评审中的应用潜力。研究发现，模型对论文正确性与阐述质量的判断与最终发表概率高度相关，但其对论文原创性与重要性的判断则缺乏预测力。结论指出，大模型可以胜任技术性审查工作，但无法替代人类对研究贡献价值的最终判断。这一发现为学术界如何规范使用AI辅助评审提供了重要的实证依据。

glossary.explanationZh: 同行评审，学术论文发表前由领域专家进行的质量与合规性审查。
前瞻偏差，指在评估时无意中利用了未来已知的结果信息。
标准差，统计学指标，用于衡量数据分布的离散程度。
贡献度，指研究在学术领域内的新发现或理论价值。
阐述，指论文对研究过程与结果的表达清晰度。
